unsafe_count.counting_rule: occurrences of `unsafe {` plus `unsafe fn ` per file
unsafe_count.why_increased: S20 restored authority dispatch that had been deleted, and that code is made of calls to existing legacy-key accessors and method callbacks. Each added operation is an FFI call at an already-documented C-ABI/accessor boundary with an explicit SAFETY contract; no unsafe abstraction's contract was widened and six authority-UB paths were removed.
unsafe_count.classification: correctness win, not a safety regression: the operation count follows restored reachable behaviour, while the set of unsafe assumptions did not grow.
